entries.text: Row number. Not a measurement, so never sum or average it.
Date of the day, from 2011-01-01 to 2012-12-31. One row per day.
Season of the year as a code: 1 winter, 2 spring, 3 summer, 4 fall. Questions about summer or winter group by season instead of averaging it.
Month number, 1 for January to 12 for December.
1 if the day is a public holiday, otherwise 0.
Day of the week, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.
1 if the day is neither a weekend nor a holiday, otherwise 0.
Weather code: 1 clear or partly cloudy, 2 mist or cloudy, 3 light rain or light snow, 4 heavy rain, ice or snow.
Temperature in Celsius divided by 41, so 0.5 means about 20 degrees.
Feels-like temperature in Celsius divided by 50.
Rentals that day by casual users without a membership.
Rentals that day by registered members.
Total bike rentals that day, casual plus registered. Rentals, rides, trips, demand and usage all mean cnt.
Compare cnt across weathersit or season groups, or correlate cnt with temp, hum and windspeed.
temp, atemp, hum and windspeed are scaled to 0-1, not physical units. Convert before quoting degrees or speeds.
